title: Credit Policy Manual, Retail Installment Contracts: Collateral and Borrower Capacity Limits by Tier
content:
**Clause.** A contract under Retail Installment Contracts is bought only when the vehicle and the borrower meet the limits of the contract's credit tier set out in this schedule: loan-to-value, financed add-on products, rolled-in negative equity, payment-to-income, debt-to-income, verified income, vehicle mileage, vehicle age and down payment.

| Tier | Max amount financed as % of book value | Max add-on products as % of book value | Max negative equity rolled in (USD) | Max payment-to-income | Max debt-to-income | Min verified gross monthly income (USD) | Max odometer (miles) | Max vehicle age (years) | Min down payment as % of cash price |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Tier 6 Fresh Start | 110% | 15% | 0.00 | 15% | 45% | 1800.00 | 150000 | 12 | 15% |
| Tier 5 Rebuild | 115% | 15% | 1000.00 | 16% | 47% | 1800.00 | 140000 | 11 | 12% |
| Tier 4 Standard | 120% | 18% | 2000.00 | 17% | 49% | 2000.00 | 130000 | 10 | 10% |
| Tier 3 Advantage | 125% | 18% | 3000.00 | 18% | 50% | 2000.00 | 125000 | 10 | 8% |
| Tier 2 Preferred | 130% | 20% | 4000.00 | 19% | 52% | 2200.00 | 120000 | 9 | 5% |
| Tier 1 Select | 135% | 20% | 5000.00 | 20% | 55% | 2200.00 | 120000 | 9 | 0% |

**Definitions used by the schedule.**

1. Book value is the vehicle's book value used for loan-to-value at origination.
2. Add-on products are the GAP waiver and the service contract financed at signing; their combined price is measured against book value.
3. Payment-to-income is the scheduled monthly payment as a percent of verified gross monthly income; debt-to-income is the borrower's total monthly debt obligations, including this payment, as a percent of the same income.
4. Vehicle age is the contract year minus the model year.
5. The down payment is cash or trade equity, measured as a percent of the cash price.

**Worked reading (hypothetical deal).** A Tier 5 Rebuild deal on a vehicle with a book value of 11800.00 may finance no more than 115% of 11800.00, that is 13570.00, and its add-on products may total no more than 15% of 11800.00, that is 1770.00. A model-year vehicle 11 years older than the contract year is within the Tier 5 Rebuild age limit; one 12 years older is not, though it would be within the Tier 6 Fresh Start limit of 12.

A Tier 6 Fresh Start deal can roll in no negative equity at all, since its limit is 0.00.
